AGO.note: Document states no rule or authority on AI harms.
Only an MoU, a study visit and a strategy in preparation; no AI system in use or tested.

facts.fact: Angola's Instituto de Modernização Administrativa (IMA) is preparing a National Artificial Intelligence Strategy for Public Services, with pillars of technological sovereignty, interoperability, public data and national talent, per the government portal.
facts.system: Estratégia Nacional de Inteligência Artificial para os Serviços Públicos

AGO.note: Study visit to Huawei's Atlas 900 A3 in China and a UAE MoU; no AI built or hosted in Angola.
